error[MBS-E1]: `sin` is not available in 3DS vertex shaders
  --> e01_vertex_builtin.mbs:28:31
   |
28 |     output.color = input.color * sin(input.position.x)
   |                                  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ no instruction for this on the target
   |
   = note: it is used in `vertex_main`; the PICA200 vertex unit has no instruction for it, and mbsc doesn't swap in a close one
   = help: use `sin_approx(x)`, which states its error
   = more: docs/shader_errors.md#mbs-e1
